arguments.command:
cd /workspace/tmp && python3 - <<'EOF'
p='biggen.py'
s=open(p).read()
old = """            v = M[(metric, target)]
            w = rnd.choice([0, 0, 1, 5, 50])
            off = 0
            if rnd.random() < viol:
                off = rnd.choice([1, -1, 2, -2, 10, -10, 100, -100, 1000])
            lo = int(v) + off if v.denominator == 1 else int(v) + off
            hi = lo + w
            if off < 0: hi = int(v) + off + w
            lo = max(-1000000, lo); hi = min(1000000, hi)"""
new = """            v = M[(metric, target)]
            fv = v.numerator // v.denominator          # floor
            cv = -((-v.numerator) // v.denominator     # ceil
                   ) if v.numerator >= 0 else -((-v.numerator) // v.denominator)
            cv = (v.numerator + v.denominator - 1) // v.denominator
            w = rnd.choice([0, 0, 1, 5, 50])
            if rnd.random() < viol:
                off = rnd.choice([1, 2, 10, 100, 1000, 5000])
                lo = cv + off
                hi = lo + w
            else:
                lo = fv - w
                hi = cv + w
            lo = max(-1000000, lo); hi = min(1000000, hi)"""
assert old in s
s = s.replace(old, new)
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
python3 biggen.py 0 > big0.jsonl 2>/dev/null; head -c 200 big0.jsonl; echo; time (/workspace/submission/run.sh < big0.jsonl > big0.out); python3 -c "
import json
d=json.load(open('/workspace/tmp/big0.out'))
print(d['status'], d.get('min_faults'), json.dumps(d.get('faults'))[:200])
print(json.dumps(d.get('snapshots',[])[:1])[:300])
"
